findings.claim: The highest-count residue writers (0x77c/0x788/0x794/0x7a0, 8461 hits each, one per plane) are NOT ega.drv blit internals despite the `cseip - orBase` label saying 'ega.drv@0x77c'. orBase (0x6ba10) is the live relocated base of the wmaze+ega.drv BLIT REGION, so `cseip-orBase` is only a raw ega.drv file offset for the actual ega.drv body (~0x1c94/0x1f6e/0xa93); the 0x77c/0xb31 ranges are WMAZE code running in that relocated window. Disassembling the relocated region at these offsets shows the documented PARTY-PANEL / sprite render loop: at 0x7ad `mov ax,0x1b0; imul [bp+4]; ...; cmp byte[bx+0x450a],0` and at 0xb2b-0xb80 `mov ax,0x1b0; imul si; add 0x43e8; ...; inc si; cmp si,[0x43ce]; jl loop` — the 0x1b0 per-member stride + the [0x43ce] party-size counter + fields 0x450a/0x453a that egadrv-blit-internals.json#memory-write-watch-tooling already flagged as the party/sprite render loop (a 'red herring' for the wall hunt). It writes the residue band because the party panel and the 3D viewport share the same off-screen compose page and the residue column band (x152..174) overlaps the panel's blit columns. This is why these writers hit residue and control equally — they are not view-content-specific at all.
